channel.title: The Quietus – Album of the Week
channel.description: Album of the Week reviews from The Quietus.

item.title: The In Between: Opening by Klara Lewis
item.description: The Swedish sound sculptor enters the backrooms with an album of unstable electronic textures united by their uncanny, reality-warping potential

item.title: Sounds of Praise: Olúsín [Worshippers] by Ibukun Sunday
item.description: The UK-based Nigerian producer stretches and pulls the sonics of sacred spaces into mind-bending new shapes

item.title: Fuzzy Logic: K-drone by Šimanský Vaľko Podracký
item.description: Three explorers from the Czech-Slovak experimental music scene burrow deep into the woodland in search of some heady drones and – just maybe – a new experience of time itself

item.title: Trust in the Process: Lost In Another World by James Ellis Ford
item.description: Recorded at London's St Bartholomew's Hospital, the new album by the former member of Simian Mobile Disco and the Last Shadow Puppets lays bare a journey of sickness and recovery

item.title: Snakes on an Astral Plane: Nāgabhūtaṃ by Neptunian Maximalism
item.description: A live album from the freewheeling Belgian metal collective, recorded April 2025, proves improvised music is at its best when the players leave their egos behind at the door, finds Jacob Manieson

item.title: Scream of the Crop: XXXXX by Arca
item.description: Her first album since the KICK pentalogy began life as a mixtape and still retains the rough energy of that looser, freer format

item.title: The Goo Place: My Heart is Running Backwards! A Martial Artist! With a Closed Fist! Woof! by Nick Granata
item.description: The debut solo LP from Shovel Dance Collective’s Nick Granata is a whimsical triumph that weaves the humdrum minutiae of modern life into a rousing and transcendent progressive folk tapestry

item.title: Roads to Ruin: Eye Wander by Ferries
item.description: The anonymous band’s second album lacks in nuance, but makes up for it for the fascinating connection between dub and krautrock it reveals
